quarterly_data.quarter: Perplexity press release: Computer on enterprise infrastructure with Valarian (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Perplexity is partnering with UK-based sovereign infrastructure company Valarian to bring Computer inside institutions' own servers and systems, including air-gapped networks: Valarian's ACRA platform runs Computer on infrastructure the institution controls and enforces access and network policies (aimed at finance, government and defense). It extends Portable Computer (launched in August, runs on user-owned hardware) and Hybrid compute on Mac.
